messages:
maya: Quick check — I'm updating the TTFT definition after the batching changes. Current dashboard uses `first_token_time_p95` computed over all requests; I want to confirm sampling and whether we should exclude cached-prefix hits. Can someone run a 1-min smoke bench on canary pool v2 (8k seq) and drop tok/s + p95? Thanks.

sam: I can run that. exact command?

maya: use:
```
bench-run --model redwood-v2-7b --profile ttft_smoke --seq 8192 --concurrency 4 --duration 60
```
Also tag the job with `cached=false` and `route=canary-8`.

cheng: For dashboard: we should compute TTFT per-request then roll up with reservoir sampling, not by token-shard aggregation. Also add a `cached` tag so we can filter those out. Otherwise p95 can be biased.

devops-bot: Job queued: smoke-bench-maya (id: jb_4839) on canary-8. ETA ~2m.

sam: Started run.

sam: Results: tok/s: 428, first_token_p50: 24ms, first_token_p95: 92ms. (cached=false)

irene: I'll add a new Grafana panel. Proposal query:
```
SELECT quantile(0.95, first_token_ms) as ttft_p95
FROM request_metrics
WHERE model='redwood-v2-7b' AND cached=false
GROUP BY time(1m)
```
And show a rolling 5m median line.

paul: small nit — p95 on 1m windows can spike. Recommend alert on 3m sustained >150ms instead of single-window.

maya: agree. I set the alert to threshold=150ms, duration=3m. @cheng can you review the dashboard PR? https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4272

cheng: will review now, ping me if you need a quick hand. also add `route` label to the metric so we can facet by pool.

sam: tests + logs attached. raw snippet:
```
2026-03-10T15:12:03Z INFO request_id=abc123 model=redwood-v2-7b first_token_ms=18 cached=false
2026-03-10T15:12:03Z INFO request_id=abc456 model=redwood-v2-7b first_token_ms=102 cached=false
```

maya: awesome — thanks all :pray:. I'll merge after cheng + infra CI green. If anyone wants the raw bench artifacts ping me and I can upload to S3.

sam: noted, thanks!

cheng: LGTM, small comment on legend formatting in the panel.

maya: fixed and merged. closing this thread.
